capabilities: Convert open Baidu Netdisk AI video note pages into local Markdown files
Batch import all currently open AI note tabs into one chosen folder
Turn note timestamps into links that open and seek the original video
Download note images into an attachments subfolder or keep remote URLs
Re-sync imported notes with incremental or overwrite strategies
disambiguation: Only imports AI notes from Baidu Netdisk (pan.baidu.com); it does not support other cloud drives or general note-export services.
extras: Unofficial project, not affiliated with Baidu or Media Extended; confirmed working only on Windows desktop, interface currently in Chinese, and requires the core Web Viewer plugin to be enabled.
problem: Obsidian users watching videos on Baidu Netdisk cannot bring the service's AI-generated video notes, with working timestamps, into their vault as editable local files.

relations.evidence: Continue editing the Markdown directly, or use Media Extended for your video-note workflow.

summary: Imports Baidu Netdisk AI video notes into Obsidian as Markdown with clickable video timestamps, batch import, image downloads, and incremental sync.
